285375390.description:
Framed Fish Fossil Specimen in Rustic Wooden Frame Sedimentary Rock Display
This item is a framed fossil specimen featuring a well-preserved fish fossil embedded in a rectangular slab of light beige sedimentary rock. The fossil shows clear details of the fish's bones and fins. The rock exhibits natural cracks and signs of age. The fossil slab is mounted in a simple rustic wooden frame with visible wear and some splitting at the corners, indicating vintage condition. There are no markings or labels identifying species or origin. The piece is authentic and intended for display or collection. Overall condition is used, with notable wear to both the stone and wooden frame.

284784616.description: Pair of natural chalcedony filled geode specimens with a combined weight of 262.5 grams. The smaller geode measures 2.5x2x1.25 inches and features a chalcedony layer over an agate layer. The larger geode measures 3.5x3x1.25 inches and includes azurite patches on the back. Both geodes have rough tan and brown exteriors with some blue mineral deposits. Interiors reveal crystalline formations; one with clear and white crystals, the other with banded brown and purple hues and white crystals. Specimens are unpolished with natural textures and colors, suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or decorative use. No visible damage to crystal interiors.

285310769.description:
Set of 2 Black Tourmaline Crystals and Smoky Quartz Point with Pouches
This listing features three mineral specimens: two black tourmaline crystals and one smoky quartz point. The black tourmaline crystals are hexagonal, opaque, and have natural, unpolished surfaces with visible striations. Each black tourmaline crystal measures approximately 2 to 3 inches in length. The smoky quartz is a translucent, prismatic point with internal fractures and a light brown hue, measuring around 3 inches tall. All stones are in good natural condition with no significant chips or damage. The set includes two gray drawstring pouches for storage or display.
